احتوشتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَوَشْتُمْ (iḥtawaštum) /iħ.ta.waʃ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اُحْتُوِشْتُمْ (uḥtuwištum) /uħ.tu.wiʃ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
